### Ready in All Seasons
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/ready-in-all-seasons
Passage: 2 Timothy 4:1-2
Points:
- Paul grounds his solemn charge to preach the Word in the reality of Christ's return and final judgment.
- Believers are called to share God's truth consistently, whether during planned occasions or unexpected encounters.
- Rebuking, correcting, and exhorting others requires steadfast patience, as spiritual fruit often develops slowly.
- Congregants should actively support and appreciate pastors who faithfully minister God's Word week after week.

### Speak the Truth in the Last Days
Author: Dr. Michael A. Youssef
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-devotional-for-september-24-2025.html
Passage: 2 Timothy 4:2
Points:
- Christians are tasked with proclaiming God's message faithfully without altering or softening hard truths for modern culture.
- Every believer shares the responsibility to witness urgently to others before time runs out.
- Sharing the gospel requires speaking relevantly to people's specific doubts, fears, and life circumstances.
- Evangelism must be practiced with patient humility, trusting that God alone can draw a heart to salvation.
